steps.name: What Should I Do? (1)
steps.objective: Talk to [Licota] in 「Nereis Gateway」, then find [Hayden] on 「Aie Island」.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Rico? What are you thinking so hard about?

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Oh, %s... You're still at the gateway?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I was just taking in the scenery.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: It's nothing, really. I was thinking I want to go to sleep.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is the lodging they provided at the gateway uncomfortable?

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: It's comfortable, but I can't sleep soundly when it isn't my own room.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: I can only sleep deeply in my room full of dolls, in my soft, fluffy bed.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: That way...

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: I don't have nightmares... If I feel even a little uneasy, I can't fall asleep...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Do you usually have a lot of nightmares?

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: I keep dreaming of who I was before I started this work, and the days I spent back then. Most people who use this kind of power probably do...

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: If I could sleep well, I wouldn't think about those things... But it keeps happening since I came here. It's been a little hard.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: I think I could fall asleep right away if I hugged a pretty, cute doll.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Oh...

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Though dolls do look a little different to me after what happened on the island...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hahaha... Still, why not try to sleep a little whenever you rest?

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: ...I left my favorite doll behind...

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Raclette made it for me... Maybe that's why... I'm like a little child, aren't I? Though I suppose I really am still a child...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Everyone has one or two things they treasure. It's like that, right?

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Yes...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Should I ask Hayden if there are any nice dolls?)

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Adventurer?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I just remembered something I need to do.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Did you? You must be busy. I've kept you here too long.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Not at all. I'll be back as soon as I can.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Back from where? Oh, you've already gone.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Oh... You're heading toward the gate. Could it be...?

steps.name: What Should I Do? (2)
steps.objective: Defeat [Scylla] in 「Chaotic Mirror」 and obtain a <Mini Picus Doll>. Then return to [Licota] in 「Nereis Gateway」 and turn in the quest.

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: Hello, %s.
(Hayden approaches and greets the adventurer. In Hayden's arms, Marie blinks as if offering a greeting too.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello, Hayden. And Marie...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, I came because I have a favor to ask.

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: Please tell me. I'll help with anything I can.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You briefly explain Licota's situation to Hayden.)

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: So the knight needs a nice doll. As for dolls we still have...

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: They're all ones with spirits living inside... If I ask them, they'll pretend to be dead.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: We can't ask living spirits to stay dead.

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: Oh, you're right.

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: When Picus was cursed, he helped many dolls. He's wonderfully skilled at stuffing them and sewing them up.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Picus... You mean that bird doll that looks like a woodpecker?

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: More precisely, he's a toucan, a bird that lived on the island. Picus was originally a tall, handsome man, but Circe cursed him when he rejected her.

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: He wasn't originally from here, but somehow he ended up staying. The curse is so powerful that it remains even after Circe disappeared.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Isn't there any way to break the curse...?

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: ...A curse that can affect an incarnate god seems to require power on the level of a god.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sigh...

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: Oh, that reminds me. Picus made some dolls recently. He seems to have taken a liking to his doll form.

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: Scylla especially liked them and took a whole armful. She said just looking at them made her feel at ease.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A whole armful?

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: Yes, a whole armful.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...A comforting doll... Maybe I should ask for one.

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: She wants to help you, so she might give you one.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll do that. Hayden, where is Scylla now?

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: She's inside the Mirror of the Abyss. She said she didn't want to get in Glaucos's way while he works on the theater.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I'll go see her. Thank you.

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: Good luck. Come on, Marie. Let's wish the adventurer luck together.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I'm a little uneasy, but shall we hurry over?)
(The mirror's interior is still filled with glass and beads in myriad colors, and mirrors of every kind. Among them stands Scylla in her doll hat, as though she has been waiting.)

lines.speaker: 스킬라
lines.text: ...I sensed a powerful presence approaching and was preparing myself... So it was you, the goddess's adventurer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello, Scylla. This is the first time since all that happened, isn't it?

lines.speaker: 스킬라
lines.text: Yes, it is.

lines.speaker: 스킬라
lines.text: I've wanted to talk with you about so many things. Thank you for coming.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you all right now?

lines.speaker: 스킬라
lines.text: As you can see, Circe's curse hasn't been broken... But I'm all right. Glaucos and I are closer now, too.

lines.speaker: 스킬라
lines.text: If only I'd had a little more strength, I wouldn't have let Circe go on like that... Circe...
(An inexplicable loneliness appears in Scylla's eyes.)

lines.speaker: 스킬라
lines.text: Thank you so much for driving Circe off this island.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It was nothing. I'm glad you're all right.

lines.speaker: 스킬라
lines.text: Seeing you suddenly reminds me of the companions I had long ago... Following the will of the gods, we fought demons and devils who sought to devour the continent.

lines.speaker: 스킬라
lines.text: It was so long ago that I no longer even remember when...

lines.speaker: 스킬라
lines.text: The demons opened a gate and poured immense power into trying to seize Freios.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Demons like Degos, then. So they appeared back then and vanished...

lines.speaker: 스킬라
lines.text: You know that name too?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, yes. Well...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You tell Scylla about your past encounter with Degos.)

lines.speaker: 스킬라
lines.text: Degos has returned, and the gate has connected...

lines.speaker: 스킬라
lines.text: Still, I'm glad. Glad you are someone who follows a god... Degos won't return any time soon, but others will surely take his place...

lines.speaker: 스킬라
lines.text: Somehow, I think you'll keep encountering them. I'd like to help, but it's difficult in this body. The curse will break someday, but I have no idea when.

lines.speaker: 스킬라
lines.text: For now, I'll work on recovering while I wait... Will you help me a little? If you do, I'll give you what you need.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...So you knew when you made that offer.

lines.speaker: 스킬라
lines.text: Otherwise, you would have no reason to come all the way back here.
(Scylla looks at the adventurer with an unhurried expression.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'd like just one Picus doll. I want to give it to a friend who helped with what happened on the island.

lines.speaker: 스킬라
lines.text: Is that all? I'd like to give my benefactor something better...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's all right. I only need something useful right now.

lines.speaker: 스킬라
lines.text: If you insist, I can't argue. All right. You know the place deepest inside, where the mirrors stand? Come there and spar with me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right, Scylla.

lines.speaker: 스킬라
lines.text: I'll go ahead and wait.
(No sooner has she finished speaking than Scylla races off somewhere among the mirrors.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'd better go too. I need to get the doll and return quickly.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, right. I forgot that Scylla is a pretty formidable opponent...
(After blocking %s's attack, Scylla sinks to the ground, apparently exhausted.)

lines.speaker: 스킬라
lines.text: I lost. Thanks to you, I've learned a lot. I still have a long way to go and need to keep training.

lines.speaker: 스킬라
lines.text: %s, you truly are special. When Circe's brainwashing left me unable to act, your attacks helped me wake up.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, I didn't do much.

lines.speaker: 스킬라
lines.text: As promised, I'll give you a Picus doll. It should bring sweet dreams.
(Scylla reaches into a pane of glass standing against the wall and rummages around.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's in there?

lines.speaker: 스킬라
lines.text: Think of it as a large bag. Circe made this space, but it's surprisingly useful. You can put all sorts of things in and take them out...

lines.speaker: 스킬라
lines.text: Living beings, like people and animals, can go inside too. You saw that child go in and put on that clumsy performance...

lines.speaker: 스킬라
lines.text: Oh, here it is. There!
(Beaming, Scylla pulls her hand from the mirror, bringing out a bird-shaped doll with a silly expression.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, this is it. It's better made than I expected.

lines.speaker: 스킬라
lines.text: Isn't it? Picus may be a doll now, but he has so many talents. You can see why the spirit Canens fell for him.

lines.speaker: 스킬라
lines.text: He's good at sewing and tailoring, making clothes for dolls and mending torn seams. He gardens, does plasterwork, and even knows perfumery. Impressive, isn't he?

lines.speaker: 스킬라
lines.text: He said he added a fragrance that relieves fatigue when he made this doll. Apparently the plants on Aie Island have special scents, though I don't know much about them.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It smells like a cool sea breeze.

lines.speaker: 스킬라
lines.text: Doesn't it? Long ago, this place was an island surrounded by the sea.

lines.speaker: 스킬라
lines.text: I came later, so I never saw it that way, but from what Glaucos tells me, it was breathtakingly beautiful.

lines.speaker: 스킬라
lines.text: Give it to your friend, and they'll be able to fall asleep in no time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Scylla.

lines.speaker: 스킬라
lines.text: I'm the one who should thank you. I've had so much I wanted to talk about. Thank you for keeping me company.

lines.speaker: 스킬라
lines.text: I never knew I was such a chatterbox. It's been so long since I talked with someone else. I'm happy. This was fun.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll come visit again.

lines.speaker: 스킬라
lines.text: It's just me today, but next time, let's meet with Glaucos too.

lines.speaker: 스킬라
lines.text: So the opening of the gate is what set the witches in motion...

lines.speaker: 스킬라
lines.text: And to think you met Degos... Hmm...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Rico, you're still here. Here you go...
(You hand Licota a miniature Picus doll. It is smaller than Picus himself, but just the right size for Licota to hug.)
(Licota stares at the doll without a word.)

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Wow... Wow...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Rico?

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: I'm sorry. I love it... It's so pretty. So cute... What am I supposed to do?
(The seemingly reserved girl cannot contain her excitement or let go of the doll.)

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Thank you, %s. A living... No, a dead... No. It's just a doll, but such a beautiful one.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: I love how soft and fluffy it is... I love the doll Raclette made me, but I love this one too...

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: I don't feel any ominous energy from it, only the maker's skill and affection. I love that...

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: ...Oh, I don't know. I love everything about it. What am I supposed to do...?
(Licota hugs the doll tightly, unsure what to do with herself.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm glad. I was worried you might not like it...

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: I think I'll sleep well with a doll like this. And it smells so nice. Like the sea... Like my hometown...
(Licota smiles with a hint of sadness.)

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: The familiar scent must have made me a little excited. I'm sorry. I suppose I was really worn out.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: I don't usually show this side of myself...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's all right, Rico. Loving something you love is a happy thing.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: That's true.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: I'll head back to my lodgings. I'm suddenly getting sleepy...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then sleep well, Rico.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: See you later, %s...
(You hear later that Licota slept deeply that day, without a thought in her head, as though a sleep fairy had put all its strength into sending her to sleep.)
(After Licota leaves, a strangely shaped creature suddenly flies down in front of %s, as if it has been waiting.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Huh?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is it a spirit only I can see?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What are you saying? Puh. Num. Ah? What's Puh-num-ah? Oh, Pneuma... That's right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Arche is looking for me in Pneuma?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. Let's go.
